paper_title: Revisiting Constraints on Resonant Axion-Photon Conversions from CMB Spectral Distortions
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, assuming B0_rms=1 nG and fudge factor f=1 (values approximate, derived from eps~3e-2 FIRAS limit via eps = g_agamma*B/(1e-10 GeV^-1 nG))
notes: Paper revisits CMB spectral distortion (COBE/FIRAS) constraints on resonant axion-photon conversion. Primary result is reported in terms of epsilon = g_agamma*B0_rms,T/(1e-10 GeV^-1 nG) (Fig 11) and directly as g_agamma for various B-fields (Fig 13). The g_agamma limit is fully degenerate with the assumed primordial magnetic field strength (B0_rms up to ~1 nG). Data points are approximate, extracted from plot; FIRAS eps limit is roughly flat (~few x 1e-2) over the mass range 1e-13 to 1e-4 eV. Assumed B0_rms=1 nG to convert to g_agamma. Also presents PIXIE projections (~2 orders of magnitude better) not encoded here.
